title: Aviation Data Engineer (Finance & Cost)
description:
We are developing the digital twin of commercial aviation, empowering our clients with fully integrated 360° industry data to drive greater efficiency and sustainability.
 ✈ The Challenge: Aircraft and airlines generate and collect massive amounts of data, but this data is hardly aggregated and leveraged in the industry. As a result, critical decisions are often based on fragmented or misinterpreted information, leading to financial inefficiencies and avoidable CO2 emissions.
 💻 Our Solution: At Skailark , we help airlines make smarter decisions — financially and environmentally. We’ve built a digital twin of the global aviation market , modeling every seat on every flight across every airline.
 Trusted by airlines like American Airlines, British Airways, Finnair, and Transavia and airports such as London Heathrow, Skailark is where complex data meets real impact.
 Ready to help shape the future of aviation?
 Tasks We are looking for an Aviation Data Engineer (Finance & Cost)with a passion for aviation finance data and modeling to take ownership of our aviation financial data layer. You will transform real-world aviation insights into scalable data models that power our product. From translating complex airline finance and operational concepts into robust data architecture to owning data pipelines and continuously enhancing model accuracy, you will play a critical role in delivering high-quality insights and value to our customers.
 Responsiblities:
 Own a set of finance and cost data models end to end: their logic, assumptions, outputs and documentation
 Translate aviation reality, such as fleet, network, operations, and contracts, into clear, structured model concepts
 Own and build data pipelines and databases for effective data modeling and updating.
 Improve existing product models and develop new ones as our product and our clients’ needs evolve
 Build and maintain data workflows and models in Alteryx, which is where you'll spend most of your time

 The ideal candidate is an experienced Data Engineer who understands how businesses operate, can translate ambiguous problems into technical solutions, and proactively identifies opportunities to improve efficiency through data and AI.

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer, Datacraft team
description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.
 We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
 We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
 We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.
 And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.
 Become a Senior Data Engineer for Bloomreach!
 Join our newly formed Datacraft team — the team building the next-generation data platform that powers internal Databricks, the Loomi Marketing Agent with Data Insights capability for Bloomreach Marketing platform. Your engineering work will directly impact how hundreds of enterprise customers access, understand, and activate their Bloomreach data internally and with data share in Databricks and BigQuery.
 The base salary range for this position at the P3 / Senior Software Engineer level is CZK 1 300 000 - CZK 1 600 000. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Everfield: Senior Data Engineer
 The Company
 Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth.
 Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients.
 Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia.
 The Position
 As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:
 Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse
 Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)
 Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools
 Further developing Lakehouse Lumen , our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users
 Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders
 You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality.

title: Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark based in Netherlands.
 We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, reliable data integration solutions in a fully remote European environment.
You will build and optimise modern ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
Working extensively with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake, you will contribute to robust, high-performing data platforms.
The role combines hands-on engineering, data modelling, automation and production support.
You will collaborate with data analysts, reporting specialists and software developers to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
This is an opportunity to apply modern cloud data engineering practices, improve data quality and contribute to the evolution of enterprise data solutions.
 Accountabilities
 Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
 Build, optimise and maintain data processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.
 Develop and manage data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, formerly Delta Live Tables, and organise data assets through Unity Catalog.
 Design and optimise SQL queries, data transformations and dimensional data models to improve processing efficiency and data accessibility.
 Integrate data from APIs, files and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, working with formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON.
 Implement automated testing and quality assurance processes, debug issues and troubleshoot production pipelines to ensure data accuracy and reliability.
 Apply Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices to manage development, testing, deployment and promotion of data solutions…

title: Data Engineer
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 Discord is looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and help build the trusted data foundations that power decisions across the company. Data Engineering is the foundational layer between Discord's raw data and the teams that depend on it: Data Science, ML, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders. You'll design, build, and maintain clean, tested, well-documented datasets that those teams can discover, trust, and self-serve from.
 You'll join one of two squads, Gaming or Ads , working alongside experienced data engineers and data scientists. This is a growth role: you'll take on well-scoped problems with guidance from senior teammates, and build toward owning a data domain end to end.
 If you enjoy data modeling, SQL, and making reliable data easy for other teams to use, read on.
 What You Will Be Doing
 Build and maintain well-modeled, tested, and documented datasets in BigQuery using dbt, with guidance from senior data engineers
 Take ownership of scoped pipelines, tables, and metric improvements within your squad, from requirements through delivery and documentation
 Write accurate, efficient SQL and Python to transform structured and unstructured data into curated datasets for analytics, experimentation, and ML
 Improve the reliability, freshness, and quality of existing datasets by adding tests, monitoring, and documentation
 Partner with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to turn clear requests into concrete data models, and ask good questions when requests are ambiguous
 Follow team standards for modeling, naming, version control, and CI/CD, and contrib…

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
The Challenge
 Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.
 You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together.
 Our current data platform includes:
 Ingestion: Stitch
 Data warehouse: BigQuery
 Transformation: dbt Cloud
 Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight
What you’ll do
 Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.
 Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.
 Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.
 Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.
 Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Who we are
 About Privy
 Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. We build simple, flexible developer tooling that make it easy to build products that put users first. By leveraging modern cryptography, we shift the status quo around digital ownership and protect the accounts and assets of millions of users.
 Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone
 About the Team
 Data at Privy is not just about running queries or building reports. We transform messy, high-volume data into scalable systems and clear insights that guide product decisions and business strategy. We design pipelines that are resilient, models that are intuitive, and tools that make data accessible and trustworthy for everyone across the company. We believe in clean abstractions, transparency, and sharing our work so teammates can build on top of it. We push each other to ask sharper questions, test bold ideas, and follow the signal in the data so we can shape better products and empower our customers.
 What you’ll do
 In this role you’ll partner deeply with product, engineering, and GTM teams across Privy to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You’ll work daily with partners across the Privy business to extract insights and build pipelines from the rich and complex Privy data set which is a unique combination of SaaS and blockchain data. You’ll build data products, metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards and reports to inform and run the business. You’ll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling while also providing data infrastructure that allows users and stakeholders to self serve their own analyses.
